newsitem.title: JAPAN: Furukawa sees 2nd half copper output flat.
newsitem.headline: Furukawa sees 2nd half copper output flat.

text.p: Furukawa Co said on Monday it plans to hold its refined copper output steady at 48,000 tonnes in the next half-year through March 1997, virtually unchanged from 47,911 tonnes in the same period a year ago.
Furukawa estimated its copper output in the current fiscal half-year through September 30 at 48,100 tonnes, slightly above planned output of 47,950 tonnes.
It said planned gold output in the next half-year was 1.18 tonnes, down from 1.339 tonnes in the same period a year ago and 1.62 tonnes in the current half year.
Silver output was planned at 19.56 tonnes in the next half year, up from 19.166 tonnes in the year-ago period and 14.5 tonnes in the current half-year.
